title: Lighthouse Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Our boats are clean and reliable family boats that are great for wakeboarding, tubing, and cruising on the bay. Renting is convenient and cost-effective, no monthly payments, no dockage fees, no storage fees, and no maintenance costs. All rentals include Valet Dockage. If luxury, comfort, and performance is what you’re looking for check out our fleet of Performance Pontoon Boats by Bennington; don’t mistake these for ordinary pontoon boats. The triple pontoon designs offer a stable platform, enhanced performance and handling with plush seating and plenty of room for water sports or just cruising for a fun enjoyable day on the water.
